title: The secret that bound Geralt to Ciri in The Witcher 3
subject: geralt
description:
Would you have claimed the Law of Surprise? 👇

The ancient custom that tied Geralt of Rivia to Ciri before she was born. Spoilers for The Witcher saga and The Witcher 3.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by CD PROJEKT RED. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Geralt claimed a child before she was even born.
In Cintra, he saved the life of a cursed knight named Duny.
As payment, he invoked the Law of Surprise: whatever Duny had at home but didn't know about.
The surprise was Princess Pavetta's unborn daughter, Ciri.
But here's what most players miss. For years, Geralt refused to take her; he didn't want her to become like him.
Destiny pulled them together anyway, and The Witcher 3 is his hunt to find her.
The child he tried to refuse became the daughter he'd never stop chasing.
